name: Create Undead

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: one black onyx stone worth 150+ GP for each corpse

targets.description: up to three corpses of Medium or Small Humanoids

upcast.text: Level 7: four Ghouls. Level 8: five Ghouls, or two Ghasts or Wights. Level 9: six Ghouls, three Ghasts or Wights, or two Mummies.

summary: At night, raise up to three corpses as Ghouls under your control.
text: You command them with a Bonus Action for 24 hours, after which you must recast the spell to keep control of them.
